sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, the league leaders with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00. The visitors are in dire form, sitting bottom of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches and winless in their last five outings. Sandbach have been in excellent recent form with five consecutive wins followed by a draw, so they will be strong favourites to maintain their position at the summit.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a home fixture against Dawley Town, a match between two mid-table sides with Stafford holding a 2-point advantage. AFC Bridgnorth, third in the table, visit Eccleshall in what could be a close contest between two teams with winning records. Wolverhampton Casuals host Wednesfield Community in a derby-style clash between mid-table rivals. Bilston Town, sitting sixth, travel to Foley Meir as both sides chase points in the middle of the division. In-form Barnton entertain Shawbury United, who have struggled badly with five consecutive defeats before a recent win. New Mills, ninth, travel to Market Drayton Town, with both sides in mixed form. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a fixture between two teams fighting against relegation fears. Telford Town, bottom-half strugglers, visit Cheadle Heath Nomads in a battle between two of the division's poorest performers. Finally, struggling Widnes Town travel to Brereton Social, another fixture involving teams battling at the lower end of the table.
